body:
on the back: “the second evening, an acrid film in the weathered bundle after the insecticide test. the tomato plants curled. later, a checkpoint opened.”

We waited for a correction that never came. Every passing driver had a different instruction and no room for one more passenger.

Perhaps the new instructions were meant to help us. They arrived after we had already followed the old ones.
title: weathered bundle note — the second evening
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the an acrid film while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
